I'll check what your training has looked like before answering. I can't see any logged training or active program in the app, so I can't check your numbers for this one. I'd be guessing if I said your lifts have stalled or your volume has crept up.

Eight hard weeks is a reasonable point to back off, though. Most lifters do well with a lighter week every 4 to 8 weeks, and the usual signs you're due are:

- Weights that used to move easily are crawling.
- Your sleep is worse than normal.
- You're dreading sessions you normally like.
- You've gone a couple of weeks without progress.

If two or more of those are true, take the week. A deload usually means keeping the same lifts and cutting the sets and effort roughly in half, so you leave the gym feeling fresh instead of wrecked.

If you want, I can build you a lighter session or week. Tell me how the last couple of weeks have actually felt and I'll steer from there.
